product_one_liner.value: SiMa.ai combines purpose-built edge-AI silicon and software so developers and organizations can build and deploy on-device Physical AI applications in robotics, automotive, and industrial systems.
product_one_liner.notes: SiMa.ai describes a purpose-built software-centric Physical AI platform and its hardware/software for accelerating Physical AI applications; the company description names robotics, automotive, industrial automation and other target sectors.

pricing_page.notes: The company homepage navigation and footer list products, resources, contact, buy, privacy and other links but no pricing link/page; hence there is no public pricing page.

employee_band.notes: The company profile reports an employee count of 245, which falls in the 201-500 band.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company description explicitly says its headquarters are in San Jose, California, and its privacy policy gives the San Jose address. | hq_country: The company profile gives its San Jose, California address in the United States.

founded_year.notes: The company press-release excerpt states that SiMa.ai was founded in 2018.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index identifies the company blog, and the index plus two engineering-focused posts establish technical content: a Modalix engineering deep dive by the VP of Hardware Engineering and an anomaly-localization/AI pipeline post by a Principal Solution Architect and Software Engineer.

public_docs.notes: The public developer portal links to multiple guides, references, tutorials and troubleshooting articles, and a separate examples portal lists numerous product examples.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live careers board lists a Principal Engineer, AI & ML Design Verification opening, so an AI/ML role is open.

model_provider.value: The product supports Hugging Face-hosted models; documented examples include OpenAI Whisper and Qwen, rather than a single fixed provider.
model_provider.notes: The official docs state that LLiMa runs language, vision-language and speech models, list model architectures and Hugging Face model sources including OpenAI Whisper and Qwen, and the Neat GenAI Studio documentation identifies the Whisper model and model downloads. This supports examples/providers but indicates there is not one fixed model provider.

compliance_certs.notes: The company has a public privacy/legal policy with a section on security, but that section states only generic security measures and the policy does not name SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, or PCI DSS as certifications; therefore the required negative list is empty.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The latest financing announcement identifies the round as Series C. | funding_date: The press release is dated September 28, 2026 and identifies the $150 million Series C financing. | funding_amount_usd: The company announced a $150 million Series C financing on September 28, 2026; this is the latest funding round found.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest $150 million Series C was announced September 28, 2026, within the 18 months before November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The open positions list includes hardware, software, accounting and manufacturing roles, but no SDR, BDR, sales representative or account executive position.

launched_6mo.notes: SiMa.ai announced Palette Neat 0.5.0 on October 6, 2026 and described substantive new capabilities including nonblocking input, quantization-aware training, and browser webcam support, within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The current management-team page is small and names four members, while the leadership search surfaced no C-level or VP-level appointment/departure within the specified 12-month window; the documented CBO appointment is from 2023, outside the window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: A SiMa.ai Sales & Revenue Operations job posting explicitly says Salesforce CRM management and Salesforce data hygiene, supporting Salesforce as a visible CRM system. | crm_stack_signal.0: The posting explicitly names Salesforce CRM management and Salesforce data hygiene.
